items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: Okay, on the octet was Warren Vache, Urbie Green, Bucky Pizzarelli and Hank Jones, Slam Stewart and Benny.

ctx.x: No, I’ll tell you why because I did what I had to do. I never got wasted on the bandstand or anything like that. Buddy Rich — I liked him very much because if he had something to say to you he’d say it to your face. But what it was with him is he wanted you to be up on the bandstand before him, and then he wants to walk up. And he wanted you to be dressed properly, he didn’t want you to drink when you were playing, he was like a perfectionist. And if you did anything out of the way then he would jump on you. So I…
I have a feeling Hank probably wouldn’t have stood for it.
